data.body: AC evidence (Gerrit 1887, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1, CI run 32210876225 success; 410 tests green incl. docs-index and ADR-number gates). AC1 publication stages only the five bridge-state files -> NEW test_publication_stages_only_the_five_allowlisted_files asserts HEAD contains EXACTLY the five allowlisted files while an unrelated scratch file and a non-allowlisted .bridge_state file are neither published nor destroyed; replacing the allowlist with git add -A drives it RED (verified). AC2 unchanged pass creates no commit -> pre-existing test_no_change_is_noop. AC3 rotation and retired-first floors preserved -> the pre-existing test_get_rotation_heldout.py / test_get_rotation_commit_heldout.py / test_binding_retired_commit.py suites now run THROUGH the delegating facade and passed unchanged in T2, which is the post-extraction proof; not duplicated per test-design section 1. AC4 repository checkpoints never publish independently -> NEW test_repository_checkpoints_never_publish_independently asserts save()/save_retired() leave HEAD and the index untouched while the local files really land. AC5 ADR 0099 -> docs/adr/0099-binding-store-internal-ownership.md (289 lines) records ownership, open-views-not-copies plus the shallow-copy trap, the three asymmetric dispositions with rationale, ordered partial states instead of any multi-file atomicity claim, the persistence-vs-publication split with the explicit git add -A prohibition, rejected alternatives (no journal, no format migration, no eager rewrite, no deep copies, no write elision), and compatibility/rollback. Two scoping corrections were made because the code required them: sole ownership is SUBSYSTEM-scoped (src/rebar/_ids.py::_resolve_via_binding_store still opens bindings.json read-only for CLI id resolution, and GHA commit-back commits the same files - both named as exemptions), and only S1's code has landed so S2/S3 behavior is marked planned. Note for the record: docs/adr/.numbers/0099 was also required (ADR-to-marker bijection gate, generated by scripts/gen_adr_index.py) and is not in this ticket's recorded file_impact.
